url.description: URL of the generated logo image

prompt.description: The prompt used to generate this logo

type.description: Type of generation: text, image, image+text

style.description: Style of the logo if generated from text

database.instructions: This infinite logo gallery stores generated logos and their prompts. The gallery supports both text-to-logo and image-to-logo generation. When infinite scrolling reaches the end, it generates new logos by merging existing prompts in creative ways.
